title: relay-run stats: fix-round rate, role times and owner wait per run

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The retrospective's numbers (median run about 20 min, 23 of 28 runs with a fix round, owner waits up to 19 h) were computed by hand from `relay-run list --json`. Measuring whether the spec check, finding kinds and self-check work needs the same numbers each time. The ledger is slicer's, so the stats belong here; ork's S123 would read them instead of computing its own.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: `relay-run stats [--since DATE] [--json]`: runs by outcome, median wall time, fix rounds per run, gate FAILs, time per role, and owner wait (from waiting phases, see the ledger waiting-phase item).
